quests.title: Newcomers in the Snow

dialogue.t: ...A little here, a little there... tiny bit more here, aaaand...
Haha! All done!
Mm-hmm! Well? What do you think? Pretty good, right? Or should I pour a bucket of water over it to make the ice a little sturdier...
Eh, you know what, never mind. We don't want anyone to slip and smack their head into a solid-ice snowman.

dialogue.sit: Losing a fight with a snowman is probably more common than we think.

dialogue.t: Hahaha... As much as Paimon would like to see that, it wouldn't be very nice to put someone in that situation.
Yeah, now that you mention it, it kinda sounds like fun... But... Ugh, no, no, no. That's not how we want Bing-Bang Finchball to make a name for itself...
(...{NICKNAME}? Is it just Paimon, or...)
(Was she seriously considering that for a moment...?)
There, done. Now for the finishing touches. Just a few decorations...
Alrighty! Hello world, Snow-Vodyanitsa! From now on, when I'm not around, I'll be counting on her to watch the stall and attract customers.
I told Odette and Alyosha about it too. They each built their own snowmen.
I actually wanted to hide a phonograph or something similar the snowman, to give it the ability to sing and talk nonstop.
But I looked everywhere, and none of the sound equipment on the market is built to run in the snow for that long...
*sigh* And I don't know anyone who's good at modding that kind of equipment either. So I guess that idea's a bust...
Wait, you need someone who's good at tinkering with technology, right? We know loads of people that could help!
Sandrone, Aino, Ineffa, Xilonen, Freminet, Xianyun... And that's without even counting the people at the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogue.sit: Do you want me to introduce you to anyone?

dialogue.t: (Sandrone...? Do they mean the Fatui Harbinger!? Huh... Whatever, it's none of my business.)
The mighty {NICKNAME} never fails to find a way. You sure are well-connected.
I'll take you up on that offer. When you have the time, maybe you could invite those tech-savvy friends of yours to Snezhnaya. Oh, except Lady Marionette of course, I wouldn't want to bother her.
I can cover room and board, et cetera, as they can help me build a cold-resistant phonograph!
Hahahaha, I might even build a whole bunch of snowmen right outside the theater...
And then, I'll stuff a phonograph inside every single one!
On Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, they'll play my songs, and on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, they can play the music Odette dances to...

dialogue.sit: And Sunday is their day off?

dialogue.t: Nope — on Sundays, they'll play the sound of the audience applauding our performances.
Cool! This is gonna be great. I won't tell Odette for now, though. It'll be a nice surprise for her when the time comes.
Ummm... Anyway, I also made some decorations for Odette and Alyosha's snowmen. I promised to deliver them today.
They should be here by now... Come on, {NICKNAME}, let's head over.
...I don't need any decorations.
Yes, you do! They'll look good on you!
I'm sure they would. But I don't need them.
Fine, maybe you don't, but your snowman does!
How about we go ask the snowman?
This is your fault, Odette. You scared her speechless.
If she answered, we'd be the ones getting scared speechless.
Aw, just hang them up already! Then your snowman can supervise Rytova for you.
If her practice requires constant supervision, then it's pointless.
Well then... your snowman can keep her company. She'll like it, trust me.
...Alright.
See? It looks amazing! This way, Rytova will definitely be much more motivated during practice!
Wait, the decoration's on already? When did that happen...
I'll make something for Rytova in a few days, too. Consider it, uh... yeah, a reward for practicing so hard.
For her, practice itself is the best reward.
...But I suppose it can't hurt. I'll pass it on to her when it's ready.
Or... you could make it yourself?
I'm making a separate one, so there's no conflict.
It's time. I need to give Rytova some pointers now. If you want to watch, you can tag along.
We still have to go over to Alosha's, so we'll go on ahead.
Tell Rytova for me that I can sneak her into the theater to familiarize herself with the stage — if she'd like that, of course.
Getting on the stage before she's ready would only get to her head.
For now, more practice in the snow is all she needs.
Continue.
Yes, Odette!
Alyooooshaaaaa...
Hmm... He's not here. Though to be fair, he did warn me.
Yesterday, he told me he had some urgent business to take care of today, so he might not make it. Well, it was worth a try.
He's probably out hunting again. Hard guy to pin down... I guess I'll go ahead and put the decorations up.
Woof!
Lyumina! So wonderful to have you with us. Could you help me find Alyosha later?
Woof, woof! Woof!
Whoa, Lyumina's a natural! Guess she's had a lot of practice... Paimon gets the feeling she's done this kind of thing a lot before...
Yeah. In the past, whenever I've wanted to send a letter to Alyosha, I've always gotten Lyumina to help.
I don't see how else I could find him when he's laying low in the wild...
Here, have a bite. Just wait a moment...
{NICKNAME}, Paimon, you wait here a moment too. I'll go look for the Kamera.
Since Alyosha isn't here, let's take a picture with his snowman instead!

dialogue.sit: Vodyanitsa runs back to fetch the Kamera, and returns with Odette and Rytova...

dialogue.t: Alright! Group photo time! Rytova, could you please do the honors?
O—Okay, Miss Vodyanitsa!
...Fine.
Ooh, you really have a knack for this, Rytova. These turned out great!
Hehe, well I've... played around with it a little bit on my own, so... Anyway, I'm going back to practice!
Miss Prima Donna, Odette, see you later! Bye, {NICKNAME}! Bye, little Paimon!
Alright, Lyumina, this picture's yours to take care of now. Run along and take it to Alyosha, okay?
Woof, woof! Woof!
Alright, we're done! {NICKNAME}, Paimon, thanks for keeping me company.
Here, these are for you. Consider them a memento.
You can wear them yourselves or put them on a snowman. They'll look great either way.

dialogue.sit: Did you make more than one?

dialogue.t: Yep, I had extra material anyway, so I just made some more. I always like to have some gifts on hand for when friends are around.
Take good care of it, and don't you dare lose it, or else...
...Or else, you'll have to come find me and beg me to make you a new one. And I'm not easy to track down during showtime, y'know!
Anyway, enjoy. I should head back and get ready for my next performance.
*sigh* You know what's sad? Even if we buried phonographs inside these snowmen and taught them to sing, they'd never be able to step onstage...
With the stage lights glaring down as the audience looks on... they'd melt away before everyone's eyes...

quests.description: You wonder how things are going at Rankova Zorya. Might as well head over and have a look…
